baseline: H0: DM-20260908-v1 60-observation residual momentum, EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: prior-only 250-observation new-high Long / new-low Short, EWMA alpha=0.25

trials.description: Separate expanding Ridge models on prior-only 250-observation high and low breakout events; standalone signed scores without B00 blending

feature_definitions.box_duration: Largest L in {5,10,...,120} with prior-only High-Max minus Low-Min divided by prior ATR20 below 3; windows end at t-1.
feature_definitions.box_width_atr: Selected longest qualifying box range divided by prior ATR20.
feature_definitions.high_event: Close_t exceeds maximum High from t-250 through t-1 after observed AdjustmentFactor unit normalization.
feature_definitions.low_event: Close_t is below minimum Low from t-250 through t-1 after observed AdjustmentFactor unit normalization.
feature_definitions.missing_history: Non-events score zero; missing box fields impute from the direction-specific training sample only.

model: Fit separate annual expanding Ridge(lambda=1.0) models on mature high and low breakout rows. Both use centered daily cross-sectional target ranks oriented toward same-direction continuation. Rank predictions within same-day events; high scores are positive and low scores negative, magnitudes 0.5-1.0. Non-events are zero. Do not blend B00 into candidate scores. Apply EWMA alpha=0.25.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only diagnostics; no candidate selection or adoption because all Train periods are known.
